walkthroughs.body_html:
In the 1890s Ivan Pavlov studied dogs.

Food (US) made them drool (UR). He rang a bell each time food came.

Soon, the bell alone made the dogs drool. 🛎️

• Before: Bell → no drool. Food → drool.
  • During: Bell + Food → drool.
  • After: Bell alone → drool.

The bell became the conditioned stimulus, the drool a conditioned response.

Examples:

  • Smell of school dinner → hunger.
  • Ice-cream van music → excitement.
  • Dentist drill sound → fear.

Your brain is constantly linking sounds, smells and feelings. 🧠
